name: Resonate Lighting

ink.use: Page background. Deep charcoal-navy; never pure black so pixels glow against it.

resonant.use: Primary warm accent: CTAs, eyebrows, active states, the glow. Think incandescent warmth.

resonant-600.use: Hover/pressed state for resonant; on light backgrounds.

cool.use: Secondary cool accent: data, links on dark, gradient end-stop, pixel highlights.

rules: Resonant (warm) always leads; cool is the answer, never the question. Roughly 70/30 warm-to-cool on any screen.
Only one gradient element per viewport: the mark, a CTA, or a heading highlight, not all three.
Text on ink uses foreground or muted-strong. Never set body copy in an accent colour.
Minimum contrast: 4.5:1 for body text, 3:1 for large display text and UI chrome.
Signal colours are for pixel/theme swatches and status, never for layout.
